services.name: Jet Ski Rental
services.desc: Plunge into an unforgettable journey across the pristine waters of Lake Havasu with Lake Havasu Jet Ski Rentals. Our premier rental service offers Yamaha WaveRunners, accommodating up to three people and providing up to seven hours of excitement. Enjoy an action-packed day for families and thrill-seekers alike. Experience the freedom of exploring the scenic beauty of Lake Havasu while creating cherished memories with your loved ones on these top-of-the-line watercraft. Book your Yamaha WaveRunner today and dive into the ultimate aquatic

services.name: Midweek Morning Ride to Sandbar
services.desc: Join our morning midweek special ride to The Sandbar! Duration 2 Hours About Experience the thrill of riding the morning glass and feel the warm air through your hair. This guided ride is only for experienced riders and passengers, and is up to 2 persons per jet ski. We'll ride for 90 minutes round trip with 30 minutes hang out time at The Sandbar. Gas and tax are additional. Maximum three jet skis plus guide per tour. More Info Guests MUST be 21+ to operate jet skis. What to Bring Comfortable clothing Sunscreen Towels Valid
